mpRules.endgame: Final stretch: once the pool is empty, the timer takes nothing and misses keep the item.
mpRules.feed: Messages and chat are at the bottom right.
mpRules.late: Joined late? You get 2 items right away, the lobby gets 2 more lives, and you join the dealing order.
mpRules.lives: Lives are shared: every miss costs everyone a life. At 0 the round ends for all – likewise when all inventories are empty while the pool still has items.
mpRules.more: More players: start items and lives are values for one player; each additional player adds 2. Start items are dealt in turn, and everyone's hits count towards the refill.
mpRules.placed: Placed items show up on everyone's map right away.
mpRules.score: Points: everyone scores their own points (hits, speed, misses); the win bonus belongs to the team. A ranking is shown at the end.
mpRules.send: Sending items: pick up an item and click a teammate on the left.
mpRules.sendLimit: For every {n} items you receive from the server, you may send 1.
mpRules.sendOff: Sending items is turned off in this lobby.
mpRules.timer: Timer (Tempo, Hardcore): after the grace period, items go back to the pool at a fixed pace – counted for the whole lobby, in turn, each player's oldest item.
mpRules.title: How a lobby round works
mpRules.unique: Every item exists only once. What's in your inventory, nobody else has.
